candidate.name: Jason Morrison
candidate.title: Senior VoIP Engineer | SIP & Carrier Voice Platforms

summary: Senior VoIP Engineer and technical lead with 15+ years of experience designing and operating carrier-grade and enterprise voice platforms. Experienced in SIP/RTP troubleshooting, carrier interconnects, SBCs, and OpenSIPS configuration. Leads production upgrades and cross-functional engineering work across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem environments. Builds Python/Ansible automation and supports containerized voice workloads.

bullets: Design, integrate, and troubleshoot SIP trunking, carrier interconnects, SBCs, BroadWorks, and Microsoft Teams voice services, including Direct Routing and Operator Connect.

Serve as a senior escalation point for complex SIP/RTP, call-routing, media, interoperability, and call-quality issues using Wireshark, packet captures, SBC/platform traces, and end-to-end call analysis.
Act as a senior technical lead for carrier-grade voice platform architecture, upgrades, technology evaluations, and operational improvements across highly available production environments.
Lead platform and OS upgrade initiatives, interoperability testing, implementation planning, and production validation while minimizing service impact.
Partner with network engineering, security, vendors, carriers, and internal stakeholders to improve platform resiliency, security, monitoring, standards, and operational readiness.
Designed and scaled VoIP services across distributed, cloud-based environments.
Served as escalation point (Tier 4) for complex call quality and interoperability issues.
Performed deep-dive troubleshooting using Wireshark, SIP traces, and RTP analysis to resolve critical issues.
Developed automation tools (Python/Ansible) to streamline provisioning and reduce operational overhead.
Helped drive the shift toward containerized voice workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
Led integrations with Microsoft Teams Direct Routing and Webex, expanding platform capabilities for enterprise customers.
Built and supported WebRTC-based communication workflows, bridging browser/mobile clients with SIP infrastructure.
Worked closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities into customer-facing solutions.
Managed Class 5 softswitch infrastructure and multi-protocol interconnects (SIP, SS7, PRI, CAS).
Designed and deployed voice services using SBCs and Metaswitch platforms.
Integrated domestic and international carrier connections.
Supported product launches and trained internal teams on new voice services.
Provided high-level support for enterprise and carrier customers.
Built and supported VoIP services using Asterisk and carrier softswitches.
Established SIP/H.323 interconnections with global carriers.
Managed underlying network infrastructure supporting voice delivery.
Optimized routing and cost strategies through LCR and carrier negotiation.
